task.description: Write ExUnit tests covering the acceptance criteria not yet covered by ELIXIR-DEV's own regression test. Specifically: (1) a test asserting Letflow.Engine.land_service_task_exhaustion/2 (Hook A), called with attempt_index == retry_limit and a retriable failure kind, produces exactly one dlq_entries row via read-back from the database (not the caller's own return value), with entry_type "event", instance_id set, and full_reason naming the classified failure kind -- plus a companion test asserting a NON-exhaustion case (attempt_index < retry_limit, or a non-retriable kind) does NOT land a DLQ entry; (2) the AC4 non-effects test: call REQ-176's Letflow.Dlq.retry/2 against one of the two landed entry types (either Hook A's or Hook B's), assert the DLQ entry transitions to "retrying", AND explicitly assert BOTH non-effects named in the acceptance criterion -- the original SERVICE_TASK dispatch is NOT re-invoked (no new attempt/side effect observable) and the instance's own status does NOT change away from "error"/whatever its landed status was. Apply this project's mutation-testing discipline: for each acceptance criterion your new tests cover, mutate the real implementation locally, confirm the pre-existing suite fails to catch it, add a closing test, then revert the mutation and verify the revert (git diff/md5sum) before finishing. Do not modify lib/letflow/engine/service_task.ex or lib/letflow/dlq.ex. Run mix compile --warnings-as-errors and mix test yourself, quote real output.
